qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Irreplaceable network of ~206 active MSW landfills, ~245 transfer stations, and specialized hazardous waste TSDFs/landfills via US Ecology. Stringent environmental regulations, high capital costs, and intense local NIMBYism create near-insurmountable permitting barriers that make landfill airspace virtually unreplicable. Landfill ownership enables vertical internalization of collection waste while capturing high-margin third-party tipping fees. Empirically demonstrated by 32%+ tangible operating ROIC and consistent 5-8% core pricing increases exceeding CPI inflation across cycles.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. #2 North American solid waste and environmental solutions leader with an unreplicable network of permitted landfills and transfer stations. Indispensable non-discretionary municipal and commercial demand drives reliable 5-7% core pricing power above inflation. High physical-world insulation from AI disruption, with tailwinds from US industrial reshoring, fleet automation, and landfill-gas-to-RNG monetization. Balance sheet satisfies the essential infrastructure concession standard with >5.0x interest coverage (5.75x) supporting A-/A3 investment-grade ratings, backed by >100% FCF conversion and resilient municipal cash flows. [5-10Y g: solid waste volume 1.5% + core price 4.5% + environmental solutions & tuck-in M&A 2.0% - capex drag 0.5% + net share repurchases 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 10-year financial record demonstrates exceptional compounding: sales grew from $11.4B (2016) to $19.0B (2025), EBIT grew from $1.54B to $3.30B, and Owner EPS compounded at 10.6% CAGR from $2.19 to $6.85. Operating tangible ROIC consistently exceeds 30% (34.3% in 2025, 10-year median 32.5%), while reported GAAP ROIC is ~10-11% due to $17.4B accumulated acquisition goodwill/intangibles (Allied Waste, US Ecology). Free cash flow conversion is outstanding at 115.5% in 2025 ($2.48B Owner FCF vs $2.14B Net Income; 2026 guidance $2.57B+). In 2026, core pricing executed at 6.3-6.4% on related business (7.6-7.8% open market), well above cost inflation. Balance sheet features $13.7B LT debt against $3.30B EBIT and $4.30B OCF, generating 5.75x interest coverage which safely meets the >5.0x infrastructure threshold.
